pull.title: fix: quarantine expired ambiguous Stripe Connect payout dispatch
pull.body:
## Summary
- stop automatic Stripe Connect dispatch retries once an ambiguous PROCESSING attempt reaches a conservative 23-hour window, before Stripe API v1 idempotency keys may be pruned at 24h
- move expired ambiguity to `REVIEW_REQUIRED` with `STRIPE_IDEMPOTENCY_WINDOW_EXPIRED` while keeping the wallet reserve held
- treat every Stripe Connect `REVIEW_REQUIRED` that already crossed the provider boundary (`attemptCount > 0`, no durable payout reference) as externally ambiguous: ordinary admin retry and admin fail+restore are both blocked until Stripe state is reconciled
- keep pre-provider review (`attemptCount == 0`, e.g. eligibility/KYC rejection before dispatch) locally resolvable
- expose private platform Transfer reference plus a backend-derived provider-ambiguity flag in the admin payout DTO/UI and hide unsafe actions
- recover a Stripe Payout reference lost after provider acceptance from a signed terminal payout event, but only after strict payout/user/amount/currency/account/Transfer metadata validation
- add unit coverage for safe-window retry, expiry quarantine, generic post-attempt ambiguity, pre-provider retry and signed-event self-healing
- add a real PostgreSQL scheduler smoke proving an old Stripe Connect PROCESSING row is quarantined without provider retry or wallet restore
- update payout architecture documentation; no Flyway migration is required

## Financial crash windows closed
A process can die after `Transfer.create()` or `Payout.create()` succeeds but before the corresponding Stripe reference is committed locally. Stripe documents that API v1 idempotency keys can be pruned after they are at least 24 hours old and that reusing a pruned key creates a new request. A long restart could therefore turn an otherwise stable retry into a second Transfer or Payout. This PR fails closed before that boundary.

Even inside the retention window, an ambiguous provider attempt is not proof of provider rejection. Therefore any Stripe Connect review reached after at least one provider dispatch attempt cannot be manually failed/restored or force-retried through ordinary admin actions. The wallet reserve remains held until external money location is known.

For the Payout-create crash case, a later signed terminal Stripe event can repair the missing local Payout reference using trusted doFast metadata plus strict provider identity checks and then reuse the normal settlement path.

## Validation required before merge
- exact-head API/Maven verify
- web dependency audit, tests, lint and production build
- production Compose contract
- Containers/runtime smoke
- Worker payout PostgreSQL smoke including the new idempotency-expiry scheduler scenario
- any other financial workflows triggered by the changed payout surface
- unchanged/latest master and mergeable PR verification before merge
